note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (jurisdiction unspecified). The total and every value are hypothetical placeholders labelled as such; segment lengths follow only the supplied values. No share rule, percentage, apportionment doctrine, fault, liability or outcome is stated; the two supplied allocations (A proposed, B alternative) are listed at equal weight and neither is preferred.
